Mathematical Formulation & Convex Linear Program
1. Weighted Multi-Objective Score
Fi = 0.35 · Ei + 0.40 · Si + 0.25 · Ri
Ei = Efficiency (Doench) • Si = Specificity • Ri = Structure
2. Biological Feasibility Indicator
ui = 1  if GC ∈ [40,60]%, Tm ∈ [55,65]°C, OT ≤ 20
ui = 0  otherwise (rejected from feasible region)
3. CVXOPT Linear Program
maximize  Σ (ci · xi)
subject to  0 ≤ xi ≤ ui,  Σ xi ≤ K (K=10)
Executive Scientific Summary: The weighted score evaluates theoretical cleavage utility. The biological constraints eliminate unacceptable off-target risk and unstable thermodynamic binding. CVXOPT then solves the constrained resource allocation problem over the convex polytope.
